build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNet backbone with depth 50 for semantic segmentation feature extraction
build_resnetv1c_backbone: build a ResNetV1c backbone with deep stem using three 3x3 convs instead of 7x7
build_resnetv1d_backbone: build a ResNetV1d backbone with deep stem and avg pool downsampling
run_resnet_forward: run forward pass on a ResNet-18 backbone to get multi-scale feature maps
freeze_resnet_stages: freeze the first two stages of a ResNet backbone for transfer learning
